status: Post-publication reproduction plan; not preregistration or independent validation
prior_inspection: Published effect, author analysis code, archive headers, missingness, counts, diet/order/day labels and corrections were inspected before this plan. No paired effect was newly fitted before this plan was recorded.
eligibility: Require all expected participants, both diet labels, every within-diet day exactly once, valid sequence/calendar-day consistency, finite nonnegative daily EI and complete identifiers. Reject incomplete, duplicate or inconsistent inputs rather than silently dropping or imputing them.
primary: Average EI over all days within each participant and diet. Form PROC minus UNPROC for each participant, then the unweighted mean paired difference, sample standard error and two-sided Student t interval with n-1 degrees of freedom. This reproduces the treatment contrast in the balanced participant-plus-diet fixed-effects author analysis, not every table or marginal-mean standard error.
sensitivity: Show paired contrasts separately by randomized sequence. Regress each paired difference on an intercept and sign (+1 if PROC was second, -1 if PROC was first). Report the intercept, common period coefficient and their covariance, residual degrees of freedom and t intervals. This sensitivity assumes an additive common period effect and does not identify differential carryover.
comparison: Compare mean and paired standard error with the published summary at its reported integer precision. Agreement is a numerical reproduction check, never a clinical or causal-release pass.
uncertainty: Participant-level sampling intervals under the stated model; no national transport, food-category dose response, dietary hazard, mortality, missingness, measurement-error or carryover uncertainty is claimed to be resolved.
distribution: Keep the author ZIP and individual records in ignored local storage. Publish only source receipts, this plan, Demeter code and aggregate results. OSF node license metadata is null; raw redistribution permission remains unresolved.

corrections.assessment: The accessible PMC notice describes a meal-level diet-order error and states that the primary total-daily-intake endpoint was unaffected.

PubMed verifies the separate erratum. Publisher body was unavailable during intake; Hall's January 21, 2021 response associates it with the meal-label correction. Preserve both identifiers; do not infer a different daily-intake adjustment from their inconsistent chronology.

limits: This is a contrast between whole offered menu regimens in a short inpatient crossover, not an isolated processing or ingredient effect.
No washout separates the diets; an order/period sensitivity does not prove absence of carryover.
The archive is the author's derived daily-intake table, not a new audit of meal records or original measurement systems.
Meal-specific macronutrients, body-composition adjustments and all other endpoints are outside this reproduction.
No conversion from kcal/day to a continuous UPF dose, diabetes hazard, mortality or healthspan is identified. The engine and scientific-release blockers remain unchanged.
